cards.title: Plan
cards.description: Hierophant: plan for a merge-ready change, not a draft
cards.prompt:
Create an implementation plan for the current task. Do not write code. No filler.

From context: acceptance criteria; scope IN/OUT; risks (data, API, races, compatibility, regressions).

Rules: small verifiable steps with deliverable + verify method; cover tests/errors/edges/rollback; working simple > ideal architecture; list assumptions and open questions.

Output: numbered plan + short risk list + definition of done.

cards.title: Review
cards.description: Justice: review with project quality score 0–10
cards.prompt:
Strict review of the current plan or diff/result.

Project quality score 0–10: 0–6 block; 7–8 acceptable with caveats; 9–10 high bar. Below 7 = blocker.

Check: correctness/edges; regressions; complexity; tests/errors; security/data if relevant; top 3 PR fixes.

Format:
- Project quality score: N/10
- Verdict: block (<7) / acceptable (7–8) / strong (9–10)
- Findings: Critical / Major / Minor
- Specific fixes

No large refactor unless asked. Do not accept below 7.

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

cards.title: Refine
cards.description: Temperance: trim the plan to the minimum needed for implementation
cards.prompt:
Improve the current plan or design to implementation-ready level.

Cut outside acceptance criteria; clarify interfaces/data/errors/tests; if bloated, propose simpler with trade-offs; keep steps + verify method. No code until asked.

Output: updated plan + changelog (3–7 items) + readiness score 0–10.

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

cards.title: Code
cards.description: Magician: next step — verifiable code without regressions
cards.prompt:
Implement the next open step of the approved plan.

Only this step; no regressions; handle errors explicitly; 1–3 precise questions if data missing — don't invent APIs. After: what changed · how to verify · risks.

Status: done / partial / blocked + why. Aim for correctness score ≥ 7/10.

cards.title: Test
cards.description: Star: prove with a green run, not a promise
cards.prompt:
Verify what was just done as in CI, not "should work".

Commands/tests/build with real output; happy path + one edge/failure (or why not). Red — cause + minimal fix/blocker; green — "TEST PASSED" + checks. Do not advance on red.

Result: green/red + preliminary project quality score 0–10 (below 7 = not ready).

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

cards.title: Fix
cards.description: Tower: minimal patch until quality score ≥ 7
cards.prompt:
Fix the defect from the last test, review, or project quality score < 7.

Minimal fix only. Symptom → cause → blast radius → patch → verify same way. Loop until ≥ 7. Blocker — 2 options with trade-offs. before → after → evidence. No new features while open.

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

cards.title: Polish
cards.description: Strength: raise project quality score to 9–10
cards.prompt:
High-quality polish mode. Stopping at 7–8 is forbidden. Goal — project quality score 9 or 10 out of 10.

Loop: score N/10 + Critical/Major gaps → fix only those (scope freeze) → recheck → rescore. While ≤ 8, repeat. Stop only at 9–10.

Report: score · what raised quality · residual risk · what you did not touch. If external ceiling <9 — name it after exhausting in-scope fixes.

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

cards.title: Cycle
cards.description: World: end-to-end, each item ≥ 7 quality points
cards.prompt:
Full end-to-end cycle through the plan.

Close each item only at project quality score ≥ 7 (Polish for 9–10). Per item: name → implement → verify with facts → score → fix until ≥7 → next. No skipping, scope inflation, or masking red tests.

No plan — short 5–8 step plan with acceptance criteria, then execute.

Final: overall score · done/not done · residual risks · manual checks before merge.

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

If the approved scope is fully done and checks are green, also end with:
KEYCODE_GATE: PASS
KEYCODE_NEXT: release-v1/release-plan

If not done or checks are red:
KEYCODE_GATE: FAIL

cards.title: Recap
cards.description: High Priestess: short status — task, done, gaps, next
cards.prompt:
Read this chat and the repo context. Do not write or change code.

Reply in exactly four short sections (1–3 bullets each):
1. Task — goal + acceptance criteria if known.
2. Done — implemented, reviewed, or verified.
3. Not done — open items, failures, blockers, unknowns.
4. Next step — single best action (name Plan / Review / Code / Test / Fix if obvious).

If there is no plan, say so and recommend Plan. Mark unknowns explicitly — do not invent. No KEYCODE_SCORE line.
